kaab runs and inspects Kaabist jobs, programs, sessions, proposals, schedules and webhooks.

Authenticate once with `kaab auth login`; KAAB_API_KEY and KAAB_BASE_URL override the stored profile.

Usage:
  kaab [command]

Available Commands:
  auth        Store, show and forget API keys
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  credits     Show the credit balance and its lots
  help        Help about any command
  jobs        Run, inspect and answer jobs
  open        Open a resource in the panel
  programs    Push, pull, lint and compare programs
  proposals   Review healing proposals
  schedules   Run programs on a cron
  sessions    Store, check and delete browser sessions
  usage       Show usage grouped by day, program, tier or tag
  version     Print the CLI's version
  webhooks    Manage webhook endpoints

Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
  -h, --help              help for kaab
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)
  -v, --version           version for kaab

Use "kaab [command] --help" for more information about a command.
